articles.headline: Combat sports icon, 10-time WWE champ Brock Lesnar retires

articles.headline: Prosecutors: Ex-UFC fighter Smith tried to run wife over with car
articles.description: Former UFC fighter Anthony Smith's arrest Monday night in Nebraska stemmed from an alleged domestic violence incident in which he attempted to run over his wife with a vehicle, according to the Sarpy County Attorney's Office.

articles.headline: Ex-UFC fighter Anthony Smith arrested on three felony charges
